_comment: Your first editable safety artifact: the limits hook checks every write against this file. Channels not listed here are still allowed (control_system.limits_checking.allow_unlisted_channels), so listing a channel is how you put bounds on it.

defaults._comment: Settings inherited by every channel below unless it overrides them

verification._comment: After a write, wait for the control system to confirm it accepted the value

SR:MAG:QF:01:CURRENT:SP._comment: Focusing quadrupole current setpoint - writable, but only within these bounds

SR:MAG:QD:01:CURRENT:SP._comment: Defocusing quadrupole current setpoint - writable, with a tighter ceiling

SR:BEAM:CURRENT._comment: Beam current monitor - a measurement, so writes are refused outright
